newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria hit by floods, more rain forecast.
newsitem.headline: Austria hit by floods, more rain forecast.

text.p: More heavy rain beat down on large parts of Austria on Friday, causing floods and cutting off whole districts, state radio ORF said.
The situation was most serious in the provinces of Lower Austria, Styria, Salzburg and Upper Austria, where the fire brigade was out in force pumping out flooded cellars, it said.
Last week the Alpine republic suffered its worst flooding this century, with water levels reaching the roofs of houses in the Lower Austrian flood plains around the capital Vienna.
Meteorologists forecast more rain over the weekend and have issued a flood warning for Saturday.
Recent floods across wide areas of Central Europe have killed 48 people in Poland and at least 46 in the Czech Republic.
